description: Connects a domain (or a subdomain of it) to a game community's website hosted on Primal Hosted: a CNAME points the name at the Primal Hosted edge, where Cloudflare for SaaS issues its TLS certificate, and a TXT record carries the per-domain token that proves the domain's owner chose Primal Hosted. On Cloudflare the CNAME may sit on the zone apex (CNAME flattening).
variableDescription: %verifytoken%: the domain's ownership token from the Primal Hosted panel, 32 lowercase hex characters (published as ph-verify=<token>).
